object.script:
s,i,o,p,m = self,input,output,property,math pgn,pgb,gn,gb,sn,sb = p.getNumber,p.getBool,i.getNumber,i.getBool,o.setNumber,o.setBool abs = m.abs
rpsMin = m.max(pgn("RPS at throttle 0"), 2.1) rpsMax = m.max(pgn("RPS at throttle 1"), rpsMin) mix = pgb("Mixture control") stoP = pgn("Stoichiometry") afrP = pgn("Air-to-Fuel ratio") prot = pgn("Overheat protection") mode = pgb("RPS control") opt = pgb("Optimal mixture at high throttle") auto = not pgb("Autostart if engine stalls")
heat,start,stall,cyl = false,false,false,false t1,t2 = 0,0 rpsOld,stoT,afrT,floS,fuelM = 0,0,0,0,0.0000001
delay = {} for i = 1,5 do delay[i] = {0.0000001, 0.0000001} end
function clamp(x,min,max) return m.max(m.min(x,m.max(max,min)),m.min(min,max)) end
function lerp(min,max,t) local t = clamp(t,0,1) return min*(1-t)+max*t end
function pid(p,i,d) return{p=p,i=i,d=d,error=0,diff=0,integral=0, run=function(s,sp,pv,min,max,maxI,mult) local maxI,mult = maxI or max,mult or 1 local error,diff,out error = sp-pv diff = error-s.error out = error*s.p*mult+s.integral+diff*s.d*mult if out > min and out < max then s.integral = clamp(s.integral+error*s.i*mult,min,maxI) end return clamp(error*s.p*mult+s.integral+diff*s.d*mult,min,max) end } end
pidEngine = pid(0.1, 0.002, 0)
function onTick() air = gn(1) fuel = gn(2) temp = gn(3) rps = gn(4) con = gn(5) dyn = gn(6) onPulse = gn(7) > 0 and not on on = gn(7) > 0
rpsSp = mode and clamp(con,2.1,60) or lerp(rpsMin, rpsMax, con)
if prot == 0 then rpsSp = lerp(rpsSp, 2.1, (temp-105)/10) elseif prot == 1 then if temp > 110 then heat = true elseif temp < 100 then heat = false end end if not heat and on and rps >= 2 then if air == 0 and fuel == 0 and temp == 0 then cyl = true afr = (dyn >= 12.6 and dyn <= 15) and dyn or afrP airM = pidEngine:run(rpsSp, rps, 0, 1) fuelM = airM*6.88/afr afrT = afr stoT = 0 else cyl = false flo = m.min(fuel/fuelM,0.1) floS = floS+clamp(flo-floS,-0.001,0.001) thr = pidEngine:run(rpsSp, rps, 0, 1, m.max(fuelM,0.1), 0.0015/(floS+0.0015)) air = m.max(air,0.0000001) temp = clamp(temp,0,100) if mix then afr = (dyn >= 12.6 and dyn <= 15) and dyn or afrP sto = (temp+(1400-100*afr))/(3*temp+200) else sto = (dyn >= 0.1 and dyn <= 1) and dyn or stoP end stoOpt = opt and 0.5 or sto airD,fuelD = delay[5][1],delay[5][2]
airM = clamp(-(1000000*thr*fuel*airD*((3*sto-1)*temp+(200*sto-1400)))/(100000000*air*fuelD),0.0001,1) fuelM = clamp(thr,0.0000001,clamp(-(100000000*air*fuelD)/(1000000*fuel*airD*((3*stoOpt-1)*temp+(200*stoOpt-1400))),0.0001,1))
afrT = clamp(air/m.max(fuel,0.0000001),0,99) stoT = clamp((temp+(1400-100*afrT))/(3*temp+200),-1,1) end else airM,fuelM,afrT,stoT = 0.0000001,0.0000001,0,0 pidEngine:run(0,0,0,0,0,0) end
if rpsOld >= 2 and rps < 2 then stall = true end if auto or onPulse then stall = false end if rps >= 2 then t1,t2 = 0,m.min(t2+1,30) else t1,t2 = m.min(t1+1,60),0 end if on and not stall and t2 < 30 and t1 >= 60 and not heat then start = true elseif not on or heat or t2 >= 30 then start = false end
for i = 5,2,-1 do delay[i] = delay[i-1] end delay[1] = {airM, fuelM}
sn(1, airM) sn(2, fuelM) sn(3, rps) sn(4, gn(3)) sn(5, stoT) sn(6, afrT) sn(7, fuel*60)
sb(1, start) sb(2, cyl) end

object.script:
pi2 = math.pi*2 sin = math.sin cos = math.cos function onTick() bilt = input.getNumber(1) depth = input.getNumber(2) dist = input.getNumber(3) vert = input.getNumber(4)
off = property.getNumber("Deck Height")*-1 tower = property.getNumber("Sail Position") factor = property.getNumber("Depth Scale")
altBow = property.getBool("Alternate Bow") altStern = property.getBool("Alternate Stern") sillyMode = property.getBool("Stan") end
function onDraw() w = screen.getWidth() h = screen.getHeight()
tilt = -bilt * pi2
floor = (sin((0.25 * pi2) + tilt) * dist) - depth
tOff = (-off * 0.8) + 3
taper1 = (-off * 0.5) + 1 taper2 = (-off * 1) + 3
gx = (w/2) gy = (h/2) + 2 - tilt * 12
x1 = (cos((0.02 * pi2) + tilt)*23) + gx y1 = (sin((0.02 * pi2) + tilt)*23) + gy
x2 = (cos((0.48 * pi2) + tilt)*23) + gx y2 = (sin((0.48 * pi2) + tilt)*23) + gy
cx1 = (cos((0.25 * pi2) + tilt)*off) + gx cy1 = (sin((0.25 * pi2) + tilt)*off) + gy
x3 = (cos((0.5 * pi2) + tilt)*21) + cx1 y3 = (sin((0.5 * pi2) + tilt)*21) + cy1
x4 = (cos((1 * pi2) + tilt)*25) + cx1 y4 = (sin((1 * pi2) + tilt)*25) + cy1
--
ex1 = (cos((1 * pi2) + tilt)*2) + x1 ey1 = (sin((1 * pi2) + tilt)*2) + y1
ex3 = (cos((0.5 * pi2) + tilt)*2) + x3 ey3 = (sin((0.5 * pi2) + tilt)*2) + y3
--
ax1 = (cos((0.125 * pi2) + tilt)*taper1) + x4 ay1 = (sin((0.125 * pi2) + tilt)*taper1) + y4
ax2 = (cos((-0.125 * pi2) + tilt)*taper1) + ex1 ay2 = (sin((-0.125 * pi2) + tilt)*taper1) + ey1
ax3 = (cos((0.45 * pi2) + tilt)*taper2) + ex3 ay3 = (sin((0.45 * pi2) + tilt)*taper2) + ey3
ax4 = (cos((-0.45 * pi2) + tilt)*taper2) + x2 ay4 = (sin((-0.45 * pi2) + tilt)*taper2) + y2
--
tbx1 = (cos((1 * pi2) + tilt)*tower) + x3 tby1 = (sin((1 * pi2) + tilt)*tower) + y3
tbx2 = (cos((1 * pi2) + tilt)*(tower+12)) + x3 tby2 = (sin((1 * pi2) + tilt)*(tower+12)) + y3
tx1 = (cos((-0.2 * pi2) + tilt)*tOff) + tbx1 ty1 = (sin((-0.2 * pi2) + tilt)*tOff) + tby1
tx2 = (cos((-0.25 * pi2) + tilt)*tOff) + tbx2 ty2 = (sin((-0.25 * pi2) + tilt)*tOff) + tby2
dy = y1 + depth * factor
by = y1 + (sin((0.25 * pi2) + tilt) * dist * factor)
--
tx = (cos(-0.4 * pi2)*2.5) + gx ty = (sin(-0.4 * pi2)*2.5) + gy - 0.5
screen.setColor(50,25,5,50)
screen.drawLine(x1,y1, x2,y2)
screen.drawLine(x3,y3, x4,y4)
if altBow then
screen.drawLine(x4,y4, ax1,ay1) screen.drawLine(ex1,ey1, ax2,ay2) screen.drawLine(ax2,ay2, ax1,ay1) screen.drawLine(x1,y1, ex1,ey1)
else
screen.drawLine(x1,y1, x4,y4)
end
if altStern then
screen.drawLine(x3,y3, ex3,ey3) screen.drawLine(ex3,ey3, ax3,ay3) screen.drawLine(x2,y2, ax4,ay4) screen.drawLine(ax3,ay3, ax4,ay4)
else
screen.drawLine(x2,y2, x3,y3)
end
screen.drawLine(tx1,ty1, tx2,ty2)
screen.drawLine(tbx1,tby1, tx1,ty1)
screen.drawLine(tbx2,tby2, tx2,ty2)
screen.drawLine(0,dy, w+1,dy)
screen.drawLine(0,by, w-28,by)
screen.drawText(w - 26,by + 6.5, tonumber(string.format("%.0f", floor)).."m") screen.drawText(w - 26,by + 0.5, "floor")
if sillyMode then
screen.drawText(tx, ty, "")
end
screen.setColor(50,25,5,100)
screen.drawText(x1 - 15, y1 + 2.5, tonumber(string.format("%.1f", -depth)).."m") screen.drawText(2, 8, tonumber(string.format("%03.0f", bilt*360)).."'") screen.drawText(2, 2, tonumber(string.format("%.2f", vert)).."m/s") screen.drawText(2, h-7, tonumber(string.format("%.0f", floor + depth)).."m")
end

function onTick() value = input.getNumber(1)
end
function onDraw() w = screen.getWidth() h = screen.getHeight()
screen.setColor(2,1,0) screen.drawClear()
screen.setColor(50,25,5,1.5)
for i = 5,40,2 do screen.drawCircleF(w/2,h/2,i * (w/32)) end
end
